# Key Largo Adventures (concept by Kerblabs)
Private boat charters aboard TIKI TIKI, a 25-foot open fisherman, Captain Charlie Filpes, departing Island Grill, 85501 Overseas Hwy, Islamorada, FL 33036.
Phone: (305) 209-9634. Email: Charlie@KeyLargoAdventures.com. Booking: FareHarbor via https://keylargoadventures.com

## Trips (from-prices as listed on their site)
- Islamorada Sandbar Boat, 3-6 hours, from $490
- Half-Day Multi-Activity Charter, 3-4 hours, from $550
- Full-Day Private Multi-Activity Boat, 6 hours, from $730
- Private snorkel, sunset or sightseeing tours, 2-3 hours; family eco-tour; large groups and custom charters

- Book: https://keylargoadventures.com
